description: This is an acceptance test class for the Targets module in a SuiteCRM application, written using the Codeception testing framework. It sets up fake data generation and contains a test scenario for viewing the targets module.

classes.name: TargetsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Targets module, utilizing Faker for test data and containing a scenario to verify the module view functionality.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method that initializes fake data generator and seeds it with a random seed before each test.

methods.name: testScenarioViewTargetsModule
methods.description: Test scenario to verify that the targets module page can be loaded and is visible correctly, simulating an admin user.
